title: Reading — Words, Lines, and a First Passage
label: ch:ta-mudhal-vaasippu
canDo: I can read a Tamil word as shapes rather than sounds, recognise a question by its last word, and hold a whole passage without translating it word by word.

payoff.summary: Thirty words of Tamil with no new word in them, four of whose lines have no verb at all because Tamil needs no word for is.
